resources.string: Find my level with a quick test
You\'ll read short English sentences and choose answers. You can skip questions you don\'t know; there is no time limit.
The result is a starting suggestion for A1–B1 stories. It is not an official language proficiency result. Your answers are not sent from this device.
Read the text and answer the question.
You can start with stories at this level. If they feel too easy or too hard, you can change your level in Settings.
After choosing the suggestion, save your changes in Settings to update your level.
Answers from this attempt will be deleted. Your selected level won\'t change.
